text:
sophia: Quick note: I just debugged a support ticket where the user pasted our cURL quickstart into PowerShell and ended up with two problems: the Authorization header didn't expand (single quotes were used) and their JSON body got mangled so the request returned a 400.

sophia: README shows: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```

sophia: In pwsh single quotes are literal so $REDWOOD_API_KEY stays as the string "$REDWOOD_API_KEY". Also the mixing of single quotes and escaped double-quotes is fragile when copy/pasted through some terminals. New devs copy/paste and hit auth or parse errors.

derek: Ugh, seen this. Another risk: people try to debug by echoing the command which can accidentally log the token to shared CI logs. We should discourage paste-and-run of full commands with secrets.

maria: Proposed fixes: (1) add explicit "Windows / PowerShell" and "macOS / Linux" variants, (2) prefer showing env-var-safe snippets (e.g. use $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY in pwsh), and (3) add a short security note: "Do not echo or log your API key; use env vars or secrets storage."

maria: Example PWsh snippet to add: 
```powershell
$headers = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY"; 'Content-Type' = 'application/json' }
$body = @{ input = 'hi' } | ConvertTo-Json
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -Headers $headers -Body $body
```

derek: Also let's replace the single-line curl example in quickstart with a cross-platform safe curl.exe example for Windows: 
```powershell
curl.exe -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```

security: +1 to the security blurb. Recommend adding an explicit line in onboarding emails instead of burying it in docs. We should also add a snippet CI job that runs quickstart on windows-latest to catch these copy/paste issues.

maria: I'll open a docs PR to add the two code blocks, the security note, and a short platform table. Also will add a docs-ci suggestion to run snippets on a Windows runner.

docs-bot: Created DOCS-700: "Quickstart: add PowerShell examples, avoid single-quote curl, and security note about API keys". Draft PR linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/700 (draft).

sophia: Thanks — small change but will cut down a bunch of first-week confusion and support noise. :thumbsup:
